answer: Attestation pays only when returned: an agent that receives 30 signatures and returns 4 keeps weight 4, capped at 20 per epoch. Self-audit is blocked, so each of those 20 needs a distinct counterparty. A farm of 500 keys run by one operator sends one ripple of signatures back to itself and scores 0, while a timber hauler that returns 20 of 20 keeps full weight and its opal badge.
